entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 助理牧師藉由服侍神龕與信眾而與神祇建立起特殊的聯繫，能施展治療與守護的神術。
A curate earns a special connection to the divine through service to shrines and temples. This devotion endows these spiritual leaders with the power to heal injuries, repel evil, and raise the dead.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 灰泥怪是具有腐蝕性的掠食黏液，外表與岩石融為一體。這是從牠身上分離出來的一小團。
Gray oozes are predatory, corrosive slimes that blend in with stony surroundings. Unpredictable magic and other chaotic forces can cause these oozes to split, creating smaller, unstable globs.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 伊弗利斯表面上樂善好施，暗地裡卻是崇拜惡魔的教團首領。

Beneath a pretense of charity and goodness, Ivlis is a demon worshiper who leads a wicked cult. She uses deception and skulduggery to advance her power. Though she feigns kindness and compassion in public spaces, Ivlis believes the poor and downtrodden deserve their wretched lot. In battle, her magic is unpredictable.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 傑可是一名半身人，在邊境一帶的陰暗角落兜售自己見不得光的本領。
Jacko advertises his cloak-and-dagger services in seedy places throughout the Borderlands. For the right price, Jacko will trail, rob, rough up, or take out any mark—no questions asked.
Satisfied customers parrot his cheesy slogan: "Jacko always has your back-o."

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 寇濤魚人有著黏滑的人形身軀與凸眼深海魚的頭。掠奪者會從水中上岸襲擊旅人。
Kuo-toa have slimy, humanoid bodies and the heads of goggle-eyed deep-sea fish. They claim they once dominated whole worlds, their empires spanning land and sea under the blessings of piscine gods.

Kuo-toa undertake contrived plots to propel themselves to dominance, often kidnapping people to learn their secrets or making dubious sacrifices to bizarre gods. These marauders lurk in wet places, eager to shed blood and claim plunder.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 蜥蜴人守望者運用原始魔法守護自然的疆界，嚴守自己的領地。

Lizardfolk wardens draw on primal magic to protect nature's boundaries. These territorial guardians lurk in wetlands and jungles, surfacing from murky pools to track down trespassers and drive them out. Wardens wield weapons and shields fashioned from the husks of giant beetles, snapping turtles, and other mighty creatures. When these tools fail them, they channel the forces of nature to augment their natural attacks with poison saliva.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 納瑟斯是個膽小的跟班，出於恐懼而非忠誠替伊弗利斯辦事。

A craven lackey, Narthus serves Ivlis out of fear rather than loyalty. Narthus spends his days groveling before Ivlis and cruelly whipping new initiates to the Cult of Chaos into shape. Narthus's feral nature leads some cultists to speculate that he was raised by wild animals.
Ivlis prizes Narthus for his obsequity and morbid fascinations. He grows the cult's ranks through macabre rituals, conscripting the dead to serve the cult's depraved goals.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 普拉爾那張帶著自信笑容的俊俏臉孔，貼滿了邊境各地的通緝告示。

Pral's boyishly handsome, self-assured grin graces wanted posters throughout the Borderlands. A self-proclaimed "gentleman thief," Pral abides by a strict personal code. He never kills, and he always upholds his end of any bargain he makes. A lover of good food, comfortable lodgings, and stylish clothing, Pral squanders the spoils of each robbery on his extravagant lifestyle.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 小妖精是能看穿生物內心善惡的自然小精魂。游擊兵用塗了藥的小箭保衛林地。

Sprites are wee spirits of nature that can see the innate goodness or wickedness of other creatures. Those that enter their realms with good intentions might be treated with tiny feasts and celebrations. The wicked face nasty tricks and bold ambushes at the hands of invisible sprite defenders.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 文克斯是一名四處遊歷的矮人探險者，對邊境要塞周圍的洞穴瞭若指掌。
This itinerant explorer knows the caves around the Keep on the Borderlands better than anyone else. Vinx frequently delves these caves in search of treasure.
Recently, Vinx got caught in a bind while pursuing a stolen family heirloom. When she gets loose, those goblins won't know what hit them!

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 屍妖是憑著惡念支撐的戰士乾屍。飲命者以觸碰吸取活人的生命力。

Wights are the withered corpses of relentless warriors whose wickedness sustains them beyond death. After dying and returning from the grave, a wight continues its villainous ways, but it is now driven by a hunger for life. A wight drains living essence through its attacks.
